summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by K Wave Media Ltd. reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting. The proposals voted on include the appointment of Class I directors, a share consolidation within a range (up to 30:1), an increase in authorized preference shares, a name change, the adoption of amended governing documents, the rescission of a 2023 share purchase agreement, and a meeting adjournment. No special situation event (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring) is disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting report, not a special situation.
